hints.en: With a start and an end: `pd.date_range("2024-03-01", "2024-03-31", freq="B")`.

hints.tr: Başlangıç ve adet vererek: `pd.date_range("2024-03-09 06:00", periods=4, freq="8h")`. Listeye çevirmek: `.strftime(...).tolist()`.
hints.en: With a start and a count: `pd.date_range("2024-03-09 06:00", periods=4, freq="8h")`. To a list: `.strftime(...).tolist()`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd

business = pd.date_range("2024-03-01", "2024-03-31", freq="B")
print(len(business))

month_ends = pd.date_range("2024-01-01", "2024-06-30", freq="ME")
print(month_ends.strftime("%m-%d").tolist())

shifts = pd.date_range("2024-03-09 06:00", periods=4, freq="8h")
print(shifts.strftime("%d %H:%M").tolist())

mondays = pd.date_range("2024-03-01", "2024-03-31", freq="W-MON")
print(len(mondays), mondays[0].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import pandas as pd

business = pd.date_range("2024-03-01", "2024-03-31", freq="B")
print(len(business))

month_ends = pd.date_range("2024-01-01", "2024-06-30", freq="ME")
print(month_ends.strftime("%m-%d").tolist())

shifts = pd.date_range("2024-03-09 06:00", periods=4, freq="8h")
print(shifts.strftime("%d %H:%M").tolist())

mondays = pd.date_range("2024-03-01", "2024-03-31", freq="W-MON")
print(len(mondays), mondays[0].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
```
